title: Vietnamese Cheesy Potato Gratin
description: A rich and creamy potato gratin infused with the flavors of Vietnam, featuring a blend of cheeses and spices.
instructions: Thinly slice the potatoes and layer them in a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the ca kho, nourishing broth, and toasted sesame oil.
Pour the ca kho mixture over the potatoes, making sure they're all coated.
Transfer the baking dish to the oven and bake for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, sprinkle the shredded cheddar cheese over the top of the potatoes.
Return the dish to the oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
